heavy_vehicle_share.source: measured - NSW Roads traffic volume counts, LIGHT vs HEAVY VEHICLES classification, WEEKDAYS period, two-way
heavy_vehicle_share.note: The model represents no freight. At the 23 stations with a classified count the station's own observed share is used; at the remaining 96 it is assumed, and the sweep is the observed range across the classified stations. Only 3 of the 34 calibration stations carry a classified count, so the assumed case is the usual one.

vehicles_per_leg.source: derived - HTS vehicle occupancy 1.3503 persons per vehicle (params/C4_mode_constraints.json) means observed vehicle trips ARE driver trips
vehicles_per_leg.note: A passenger rides in a vehicle that is already counted, so the modelled vehicle count is the car legs alone and a ride leg correctly contributes none. This holds only while the modelled ride:car ratio matches the observed passenger:driver ratio, which is what DECISIONS.md 9.8 constrains asc_car_passenger to reproduce. What stays genuinely unmodelled is the escort trip: B2 generates none, so a driver travelling solely to carry someone else is absent. That is a stated limitation, not a fitted parameter.
